brief: The canvas displays a highly abstracted self-portrait composed of numerous interlocking planar facets. These facets define a complex, crystalline geometry, creating a deep sense of volumetric space. The primary visual interest lies in the careful detailing of the materials; light interacts with the surfaces to reveal minute, complex textural variations. Instead of a smooth sheen, the specular highlights appear broken up and patterned, suggesting materials like etched metal or polished stone. The structure remains fixed, allowing the viewer to examine how these highly defined textures alter the perceived depth and reflective quality across the entire form.

statement: This sketch presents a static, crystalline self-portrait composed of numerous interlocking planar facets arranged in three-dimensional space. Each facet is a flat polygon with subtle texture and carefully modulated lighting to simulate the appearance of etched metal or polished stone. The composition avoids smooth reflections in favor of broken, patterned specular highlights that reveal minute textural variations across surfaces. The fixed geometry allows viewers to examine how these highly defined materials alter perceived depth and reflective quality throughout the form, creating a sense of volumetric space without motion.
